terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Duo, you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully.

eligibility.heading: Eligibility
body: You must be at least 18 years old to use Duo.
By creating an account, you represent that all information you provide is accurate and truthful.

yourAccount.heading: Your Account
body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

communityStandards.heading: Community Standards
body: Treat other members with respect. Harassment, hate speech, and abusive behavior are not tolerated.
We reserve the right to remove content or suspend accounts that violate these standards.

coinsPremiumPayments.heading: Coins & Premium Payments
body: Duo Coins and premium subscriptions are purchased through our supported payment methods, including eSewa.
All purchases are final except where required by law.

safety.heading: Safety
body: Never share personal financial information with other members.
Report suspicious behavior immediately through the app.

accountTermination.heading: Account Termination
body: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.
You may delete your account at any time from Settings.

disclaimersLiability.heading: Disclaimers & Liability
body: Duo is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind.
We are not liable for interactions between users that occur outside the platform.

changesToTerms.heading: Changes to These Terms
body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of Duo constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

contactUs.heading: Contact Us
body: If you have questions about these Terms, contact us at support@duo.app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Duo collects, uses, and protects your information.

informationWeCollect.heading: Information We Collect
body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your profile details, photos, and messages.
We also collect usage data and device information to improve our service.

howWeUseInformation.heading: How We Use Information
body: We use your information to provide matchmaking, personalize your experience, and ensure safety.
We may use aggregated data for analytics and product improvement.

sharingInformation.heading: Sharing Information
body: We do not sell your personal data.
We may share information with service providers who help us operate Duo, and as required by law.

yourChoicesRights.heading: Your Choices & Rights
body: You can access, update, or delete your account information from Settings.
You may contact us to request a copy of your data.

dataRetentionSecurity.heading: Data Retention & Security
body: We retain your data as long as your account is active or as needed to comply with legal obligations.
We use industry-standard measures to protect your data.

changesToPolicy.heading: Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes.

contactUs.heading: Contact Us
body: If you have questions about this policy, contact us at privacy@duo.app.

items.q: How do I create a match?
items.a: Swipe right on profiles you're interested in. If they swipe right too, it's a match!

items.q: How do I edit my profile?
items.a: Go to Settings > Edit Profile to update your photos, bio, and preferences.

items.q: How does the wallet and coins system work?
items.a: Coins can be purchased with real money via eSewa and used to unlock premium features.

items.q: How do I report or block someone?
items.a: Open their profile and tap the menu icon, then choose Report or Block.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Go to Settings > Account and select Delete Account. This action is permanent.

items.q: How do I verify my profile?
items.a: Go to Settings > Verification and follow the steps to take a verification selfie.
Yes, all payments are processed securely through eSewa. We never store your payment credentials.
